title: Plouarzel Hampden Memorial
memorial_type: Memorial stone and inscribed marble tablet
memorial_details: Memorial stone and inscribed marble tablet at the crash site, Plouarzel, Finistère.
narrative: Hampden AD738 of 106 Squadron, coded ZN-?, departed Coningsby at 1900 on 4 April 1941 for Brest. The aircraft was hit by Flak Regiment 100 and shot down, crashing at Saint-Renan. All four crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Hit by Flak Regiment 100; shot down
